净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Combines earnings yield with a size trend deviation. When a stock is cheap (high earnings yield) and its market cap is shrinking relative to its own 60-day average (negative size deviation), the factor amplifies the signal. This conditions value on a size downturn, potentially capturing overlooked value in temporarily distressed small caps.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

size_trend_value = cheapness * -((log_size - ts_mean(60, log_size)) / ts_mean(60, log_size))
依赖列: pe_ttm, mkt_cap_float

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

size_trend_value = cheapness * -((log_size - ts_mean(60, log_size)) / ts_mean(60, log_size))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_mean(log_size) → 窗口 60 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  2. 步骤2：subtract(log_size, v1(ts_mean)) → 减法：x - y
  3. 步骤3：ts_mean(log_size) → 窗口 60 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  4. 步骤4：divide(v2(subtract), v3(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  5. 步骤5：neg(v4(divide)) → 返回-x
  6. 步骤6：multiply(cheapness, v5(neg)) → 乘法：x × y

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 pe：pe_ttm
  2. 计算 cheapness：1.0 / pe
  3. 计算 cheapness：cheapness.where(cheapness > 0, 空)
  4. 计算 size：np.log1p(mkt_cap_float.abs())
  5. 计算 size_ma：size.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=20).mean()
  6. 计算 size_dev：(size - size_ma) / size_ma
  7. 计算 signal：cheapness * (-size_dev)
  8. 计算 signal：signal
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_size_trend_value(df): df_copy = df.copy() pe = df_copy["pe_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) cheapness = 1.0 / pe cheapness = cheapness.where(cheapness > 0, np.nan) size = np.log1p(df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].abs()) size_ma = size.rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean() size_dev = (size - size_ma) / size_ma.replace(0, np.nan) signal = cheapness * (-size_dev) signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return pd.Series(signal, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_size_trend_value")
